neighbours.label: endocytic-pathway vocabulary: the pieces of 'endocytosis' and 'endosome/endosomal'
fire: Iron bound to transferrin is taken into the cell through endocytosis.
After uptake, the receptor is delivered to early endosomes within minutes.
The toxin escapes from the endosomal lumen when the pH drops.
Clathrin-coated pits are the main route of endocytosis in neurons.
Late endosomes carry the ligand deeper into the cytoplasm.
Blocking endocytosis prevented the nanoparticles from entering the cells.
The fusion of endosomal vesicles depends on small Rab proteins.
Cholesterol-rich particles are internalized by endocytosis in the liver.
quiet: Iron bound to transferrin is carried through the blood to the marrow.
After synthesis, the receptor is delivered to the Golgi within minutes.
The toxin escapes from the nuclear envelope when the cell divides.
Voltage-gated channels are the main route of calcium entry in neurons.
Secretory granules release the hormone by exocytosis at the surface.
Blocking transcription prevented the genes from being expressed in the cells.
The fusion of mitochondrial membranes depends on small GTPase proteins.
Invading bacteria are engulfed by phagocytosis in the liver.
